placeholder.body: This screen will be built in a later step.

auth.signInLead: Sign in to your masjid or surau account.
auth.magicLead: Rather not type a password? We will email you a sign-in link.
auth.magicSent: If this email is registered, a sign-in link is on its way. Check your inbox (and spam folder).
auth.signUpLead: For committee members registering a masjid or surau. If you were invited, use the link in your invitation instead.
auth.signUpDone: Nearly done. We have sent a confirmation email. Click the link in it to continue.
auth.resetLead: Enter your email. We will send a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If this email is registered, a link is on its way. Check your inbox.

onboarding.title: Register your masjid
onboarding.lead: You will be the Pengerusi for this masjid and can invite other committee members afterwards.
onboarding.name: Masjid or surau name
onboarding.nameHint: For example: Masjid Al-Hidayah Taman Seri Murni
onboarding.zoneHint: The JAKIM zone used for prayer times.
onboarding.invitedHint: Invited by another masjid? Open the invitation link you were sent.
onboarding.removedBody: Your account was deactivated by your masjid's Pengerusi. Contact the Pengerusi if this is a mistake.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.haveAccount: Already have an Imarah account with this email?
invite.wrongAccount: You are signed in as {email}. This invitation is for a different email. Sign out, then open this link again.

status.used: This invitation has already been used. Please sign in.
status.revoked: This invitation was cancelled. Ask the Pengerusi to send a new one.
status.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the Pengerusi to send a new one.
status.not_found: This invitation link is not valid. Check the link you were given.

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name
settings.usersLead: Invite committee members, change roles, deactivate accounts
settings.logoLead: Upload a logo for the sidebar, e-receipts and reports

users.title: Users
users.lead: Who can use Imarah for your masjid.
users.emailSent: Invitation sent to {email}. You can also share the link below.
users.emailNotSent: The invitation for {email} is ready. No email was sent, so copy the link below and share it yourself.
users.whatsappText: Assalamualaikum. You are invited to use Imarah for our masjid. Open this link: {link}
users.linkHelp: This link works for 7 days and only for the invited email. Do not share it in public groups.
users.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate {name}? They will no longer be able to sign in to this masjid.

forbidden.title: No access
forbidden.body: Your role does not allow this page. If you need it, ask the Pengerusi to change your role.

admin.signInLead: For the Imarah team only. Masjid accounts cannot sign in here.
admin.twoStepLead: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code.
admin.enrolLead: Admin accounts must use an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator).
admin.enrolStep1: Open the authenticator app on your phone.
admin.enrolStep2: Scan the QR code below, or type the secret key.
admin.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
admin.loggedNotice: Every view and change here is recorded in that masjid's audit log.
admin.loadFailed: The masjid list could not be loaded.

email.inviteBody:
Assalamualaikum,

{masjid} has invited you to use Imarah as {role}.

Open this link to set your password and sign in:
{link}

The link works for 7 days. If you do not recognise this invitation, ignore this email.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.missing_fields: Please fill in every field correctly.
errors.invalid_credentials: Email or password is not correct.
errors.email_not_confirmed: Your email is not confirmed yet. Click the link in the confirmation email first.
errors.email_taken: This email is already registered. Please sign in.
errors.weak_password: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.link_expired: This link has expired or was already used. Please ask for a new one.
errors.password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
errors.platform_admin: Admin accounts cannot join a masjid.
errors.not_platform_admin: This is not an admin account.
errors.already_member: Your account already belongs to a masjid. One account is for one masjid only.
errors.already_in_masjid: This email is already an active member of your masjid.
errors.account_exists: This email already has an Imarah account.
errors.invitation_not_found: This invitation link is not valid.
errors.invitation_used: This invitation has already been used.
errors.invitation_wrong_email: This invitation is for a different email.
errors.name_required: Please fill in the masjid name.
errors.last_pengerusi: The masjid must keep at least one active Pengerusi.
errors.bad_code: That code is not correct. Try the latest code from your app.
errors.logo_too_big: This file is larger than 1 MB. Please make it smaller first.
errors.logo_wrong_type: Only PNG or SVG files are accepted.
errors.logo_unsafe_svg: This SVG contains code that is not allowed. Please export it again as a plain SVG or as a PNG.
errors.phone_bad: Phone number is not valid. For example: 012-345 6789.
errors.phone_excel: This phone number is damaged (for example 1.23E+09). Type the full number again.
errors.whatsapp_needs_mobile: WhatsApp consent needs a mobile number (starting 01).
errors.plan_limit: The Asas plan allows up to {limit} households. Upgrade the plan to add more.
errors.household_in_use: This household cannot be deleted because khairat or finance records refer to it.
errors.dob_bad: Date of birth is not valid.
errors.ic_bad: Enter only the last 4 digits of the IC number.
errors.csv_empty: The file is empty or has no data rows.
errors.csv_no_name_column: Name column not found. Use the template: the first row must have "nama_ketua".
errors.csv_too_many_rows: Too many rows (max 2,000). Split it into several files.
errors.import_partial: The import stopped part way. Check the kariah list before importing again.

logo.title: Masjid logo
logo.lead: The logo shows in the sidebar and app, and later on e-receipts, kariah cards and monthly reports.
logo.noLogo: No logo yet. The masjid's initials are shown for now.
logo.fileHint: PNG or SVG, up to 1 MB. A square logo works best.
logo.confirmRemove: Remove this logo? The masjid's initials will show instead.

kariah.title: Kariah
kariah.empty: No households yet. Add one or import from CSV.
kariah.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {no members} one {# member} other {# members}}
kariah.phoneHint: For example: 012-345 6789. Leave empty if none.
kariah.consentDateNote: The consent date is recorded automatically when a box is ticked.

consent.whatsappText: This household agrees to receive masjid announcements and reminders by WhatsApp. They can withdraw at any time.
consent.pdpaText: This household agrees that the details above are kept by the masjid for kariah and khairat matters only, and not shared with others.

kariah.icNote: Only the last 4 digits of the IC number are stored. The full number is never stored.
kariah.icTrimmed: The full number was cut. Only the last 4 digits will be stored.
kariah.confirmDeleteHousehold: Delete the household of {name} and all its members? This cannot be undone.

kariahImport.title: Import households from CSV
kariahImport.lead: One row per household. Nothing is saved until you check the preview and press Import.
kariahImport.templateHelp: Fill in the template in Excel or Google Sheets, then save it as CSV. Columns: nama_ketua, alamat, telefon, whatsapp (ya/tidak), pdpa (ya/tidak).
kariahImport.counts: {valid} rows ready to import, {invalid} rows have errors and will be skipped.
kariahImport.overLimit: Your plan allows only {room} more households. Remove some rows or upgrade the plan.

rowError.phone_excel: Excel damaged the phone number (for example 1.23E+09). Type it again as text.
rowError.consent_bad: The whatsapp and pdpa columns must be "ya" or "tidak"

kariahImport.confirmHelp: Only rows without errors are imported. For rows with errors, fix them in the file and import again later.

history.title: Change history
history.lead: Who changed what, and when. For personal details only the fact of a change is recorded, not its content.
